QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/private_access.h:15` defines it as `private_##member` when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, and as plain `member` when it is.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to `private_##member` and that defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro expand to the plain member name.
